sentences.ar: جحا قعد على غصن وصار يقصه.
sentences.en: Juha sat on a branch and started cutting it.
Someone passed and said: you will fall!

sentences.ar: جحا ما سمع منه، وبعد شوي وقع.
sentences.en: Juha did not listen, and a little later he fell.

sentences.ar: ركض ورا الرجل وقال: إنت بتعرف الغيب!
sentences.en: He ran after the man and said: you know the unseen!
Tell me when I will die!
